figures.finding: Under the Turkish Civil Code those without discernment, minors and persons under restriction have no capacity to act, so a minor's contract is made through or with the parents' consent; the rule on a minor with discernment acting with the legal representative's consent (art. 16) and any set-aside wasn't read.

value.rule: minors have no capacity to act (TMK art. 14)

figures.applies: Read from the Ministry of Family and Social Services' excerpt of the Code, which leaves out arts. 11-12 and 16; the Code reaches every contract. Majority (art. 11) and the consent rule are blockers.
